basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Specialists at ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif, Patna is on 20 November 2026, with reporting from 9 am to 10:30 am at the Office of Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif, Patna-801505. content_sections.heading: About the Hospital
content_sections.text: ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif is a hospital in Patna. This notice is issued by its Medical Superintendent for engaging Specialists on contract in the departments listed below, and refers to ESIC Headquarters letters for remuneration and terms.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice gives 6 vacancies, one in each department, as follows. The split of these vacancies between the Full Time and Part Time posts is not specified in the notice. Age limit for all three posts: not exceeding 67 years as on the date of interview. The notice mentions age relaxation for OBC candidates but prints no relaxation amounts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_required: PG Degree/Diploma in concerned Specialty and registered with Medical Council of India.
rows.experience: PG Degree or equivalent in concerned specialty from Recognized University with 03 years experience after acquiring PG degree, OR minimum of 05 years experience in the concerned specialty after acquiring PG Diploma

rows.item: Visiting charge in case of emergency call

rows.amount: Rs. 800 per hour for every additional hour (additional hours to be justified by the Medical Superintendent)

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Full Time Specialists are recruited for 01 year on contract or till joining of regular incumbents, whichever is earlier. The contract will be extendable for a further period of 02 more years based on satisfactory performance. Part Time Specialists are recruited for 01 year on contract from the date of joining or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. The selected specialist must have a professional indemnity policy covering the period desired by ESIC. The minimum sum assured per annum is Rs. 30 Lakhs for Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeon, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons, etc., Rs. 20 Lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynecologist, Obstetrician, etc., and at least Rs. 10 Lakhs for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists, etc. A copy of the insurance and premium receipt must be submitted within 07 days from the date of engagement. The remaining terms and conditions apply as per Hqrs. No. U-13/14/38/2020Med-I (ESIC/SC) dated 02/02/2021. At joining, selected contractual candidates sign an Agreement as per ESIC norms on non judiciary stamp paper of Rs. 100/- and submit Rs. 30000/- as bond amount, refundable after completion of satisfactory performance of the bond period.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid as a Demand Draft in favor of ESIC Fund Account No. 1 payable at State Bank of India, Anishabad Branch. The application fee once paid is non refundable. The application with fee (wherever applicable) must be submitted separately for each post.

rows.fee: Exempted from payment of application fees

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested candidates to appear for the interview at the venue and time above. The application form is Annexure A on page 8 of the notice, which asks for post and specialty applied for, personal details, qualifications, Medical Council registration number, work experience, NOC status and Demand Draft details. A note on page 1 says the resume must be submitted 07 days prior to the interview date; how it is to be submitted is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates bring two sets of self attested copies of the following, along with originals: SSC/10th Standard Certificate or equivalent proof of date of birth, MBBS, PG Degree Certificate, Attempt Certificate of MBBS, valid MCI/Registration Certificate, SC/ST/OBC certificate and experience certificate, etc. They also bring two recent passport size photographs and proof of residence. Documents to be submitted with the application, failing which the application shall be summarily rejected: Matriculation certificate as proof of age Permanent Registration with MCI/State Medical Council MBBS Degree and MD/MS/Diploma/DNB Degree Attempt Certificates and Mark Sheets of MD/Diploma/DNB degree and MBBS degree Experience Certificate, wherever required NOC from present employer, if applicable Application Fees, if applicable Caste Certificate (if applicable) in the prescribed format of Govt. of India Two recent Passport Size Photographs Self attested copy of Aadhar/other document OBC certificate (Non-creamy layer), if applicable EWS certificate, if applicable A candidate currently in employment must bring the experience (working) certificate and No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if applicable, failing which the candidature is liable to rejection. OBC candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation must submit the community certificate in the prescribed proforma, failing which the benefit will not be given or the application may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at the office of the Medical Superintendent from 9 am to 10:30 am; those reporting after 10:30 am will not be entertained for the walk-in interview. The interview starts at 11 am onwards. The decision of the selection board is final on all aspects of selection. Selection is subject to the candidate proving medical fitness and verification of character and antecedents. Selected candidates join immediately or on the date indicated in the offer of appointment/engagement likely to be issued.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Vacancies are likely to change depending upon the actual requirement at the time of interview. The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to fill up all or not to fill up any vacancy/post, and to alter the date or cancel the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview. Candidates working in Government Service must produce a No Objection Certificate from their organization/department at the time of interview. The appointment shall not offer any right or preference for regular appointment. The claim for any service benefit like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Seniority, Promotion and leave will not be admissible. Private practice of any kind will not be allowed. Hostel accommodation/quarters will not be provided.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ESIC Phulwarisharif Specialist walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The first walk-in interview is on 20.11.2026. It is held thereafter on the 3rd Friday of every month till March, 2027 as per requirement, and on the next working day in case of a holiday.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting is from 9 am to 10:30 am at the Office of Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif, Patna-801505. The interview starts at 11 am onwards, and candidates reporting after 10:30 am will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. How many Specialist vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: Anesthesiology UR-1, Biochemistry UR-1, Dermatology UR-1, ENT SC-1, Radiology OBC-1 and Psychiatry UR-1. The notice says vacancies are likely to change depending on actual requirement at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ESIC Specialist posts?
faq.answer: Full Time Junior and Senior Specialists need a PG Degree in the concerned specialty, registered with Medical Council of India. Part Time Specialists need a PG Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty, registered with Medical Council of India, plus the experience listed above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 67 years as on the date of interview, for Junior Specialist, Senior Specialist and Part Time Specialists alike.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay of a Part Time Specialist?
faq.answer: Part Time Specialists get Rs. 60000 fixed for 16hr/week, Rs. 15000 visiting charge in case of an emergency call, and Rs. 800 per hour for every additional hour. Full Time pay is as per ESIC Hqrs. Office Letter No. OM Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 400/- for General, EWS and OBC and Rs. 100 for SC/ST, paid by Demand Draft in favor of ESIC Fund Account No. 1 payable at State Bank of India, Anishabad Branch. Female candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring two sets of self attested copies with originals of the age proof, MBBS and PG certificates, registration certificate, category and experience certificates, and two recent passport size photographs with proof of residence. NOC is needed if currently employed.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ESIC Specialist job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Full Time Specialists are engaged for 01 year on contract (extendable by 02 more years on satisfactory performance), and Part Time Specialists for 01 year. The appointment does not offer any right or preference for regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Is a bond or deposit required?
faq.answer: Yes. At joining, selected candidates sign an Agreement on Rs. 100/- non judiciary stamp paper and submit Rs. 30000/- as bond amount, refundable after satisfactory completion of the bond period.
